title: Ludka
description: A mod that adds a functional casino roulette wheel
body:
This mod adds a fully featured roulette wheel with animations, a chip system, and a user-friendly interface.
[Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) is required for the mod to work
Commands /chips balance - Check the player's balance
/chips give - Give the player some chips
/chips take - Take chips from a player
/chips set - Set the player's balance
